verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own mobile SDKs: the Android SDK automatically reports errors and exceptions, and Apple platforms are supported via sentry-cocoa. Its CLI uploads iOS/Android debug information files so Sentry can extract stack traces from crash reports on compiled platforms. A community comment corroborates the symbolication work behind this. Missing for 10: explicit NDK/native-C++ crash capture evidence, documentation of device/OS/app-version context attached to crash events, and hands-on corroboration of mobile crash reporting.
